runners.name: Bletchley
runners.comment: BLETCHLEY chased just off the inside down the backstretch and then four wide through the turn, got let out spinning four wide into upper stretch, seized command straightened away and drew clear under a light drive, then got ridden out lightly through to the finish.

runners.name: D. C.'s Army
runners.comment: D. C.'S ARMY three paths off the inside in pursuit from just off the pace down the backstretch, tucked inside through the turn coming under urging three furlongs out, cut the corner into upper stretch, proved no match for the top one while running on to just get up for the place honors in the last jumps to the finish.

runners.name: Louisiana Baby
runners.comment: LOUISIANA BABY broke on top despite awkwardly getting into stride when lunging and then bobbling, raced seven to eight paths off the rail showing the way down the backstretch, darted to the two path into the turn and remained patiently handled until placed to coaxing with five-sixteenths to run, spun just off the inside into upper stretch, yielded the front straightened away and weakened in the late stages.

runners.name: Oyakata
runners.comment: OYAKATA broke in at the start bumping LE PATRON into JOVEN, then bumped JOVEN, race six paths off the inside down the backstretch and then three wide through the turn, tipped three to four wide into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Le Patron
runners.comment: LE PATRON got bumped at the start by the aforementioned foe and in turn bumped JOVEN, chased four paths off the inside down the backstretch and then just off the inside through the turn under prolonged coaxing from the half mile pole, angled three to four wide into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Joven
runners.comment: JOVEN got bumped at the start by LE PATRON due to pressure from OYAKATA, then got bumped by that rival himself, chased four then three wide under urging from the seven-sixteenths pole, angled five to six wide into upper stretch and faltered in the drive.

runners.name: Spying
runners.comment: SPYING broke a bit awkwardly, stalked the pace on the outside under a snug hold, turned up the pressure on the leader in the two to three path on the turn, took the lead at seven-sixteenths pole, turned into the stretch under the crop, responded well while battling outside of BASEBALL LADY in the drive, disposed of that opponent into the final sixteenth and held under strong urging.

runners.name: Kyle's Mom
runners.comment: KYLE'S MOM bumped with BASEBALL LADY at the start, was rated just off the pace, saved ground on the turn, was given her cue outside the seven-sixteenths pole, moved to the two path late on the bend, swung out to the five path into the stretch and finished willingly for the place.

runners.name: Baseball Lady
runners.comment: BASEBALL LADY bumped with rivals on both sides at the start, went to the front then showed the way, was coaxed along late on the backstretch, vied inside under threat on the turn, lost the advantage at the seven-sixteenths pole, raced under the crop outside the quarter-pole, fought on inside the winner until near the sixteenth-pole then weakened but held the show.

runners.name: Royal Bobbie
runners.comment: ROYAL BOBBIE bumped with BASEBALL LADY at the start, dropped back then settled well off the pace, was asked in the four then three path on the turn, came out to the six path into the stretch and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Ur Desire
runners.comment: UR DESIRE dropped back off the pace then moved out outside the seven-eighths pole, was rated on the outside, ranged up to make a bid in the three to four path on the turn, was roused nearing the quarter-pole, battled outside of two foes in upper stretch, dropped back into the final furlong and tired.

runners.name: Racing Colors
runners.comment: RACING COLORS dropped back early then settled at the rear, was asked in the five then four path on the turn, turned into the stretch in the seven path, drifted in around the furlong marker and failed to respond.

runners.name: Ogugua
runners.comment: OGUGUA chased along the inside coming under coaxing near the quarter pole, spun two to three wide into upper stretch, seized command from a leg weary leader straightened away, dug in under threat to the outside to the eighth pole, rebuffed that challenge and edged away to the finish kept to task.

runners.name: Mitofury
runners.comment: MITOFURY brushed the off side stall at the start, chased three wide coming under a ride at the five-sixteenths pole, swung four wide into upper stretch, ran on latched on to the eighth pole, got shaken off late while safe for the place honors.

runners.name: Tartah
runners.comment: TARTAH broke out at the start brushing EASTPOINTE, chased along the inside coming under urging near the quarter pole, angled four to five wide into upper stretch and offered up a mild bid.

runners.name: Shake My Hand
runners.comment: SHAKE MY HAND broke out at the start bumping SPHINX, chased three wide under encouragement from three furlongs out, angled five to six wide into upper stretch and offered up a mild bid.

runners.name: Loan Ranger
runners.comment: LOAN RANGER chased three to four paths off the rail until tucked inside just inside the half mile pole, got ridden along at the three-eighths marker, cut the corner into upper stretch, kept on to the finish and was outfinished in the final jumps.

runners.name: Monaco Crown
runners.comment: MONACO CROWN coaxed from the gate, chased four to five paths off the inside down the backstretch and then two to three wide through the turn, angled six wide into upper stretch and passed tired rivals.

runners.name: Private Banker
runners.comment: PRIVATE BANKER chased three then two wide under a ride from three furlongs out, angled four to five wide into upper stretch and made no headway.

runners.name: Eastpointe
runners.comment: EASTPOINTE got brushed at the break by TARTAH, chased two to three wide under urging from the three-eighths marker, angled six to seven wide into upper stretch, offered no response.

runners.name: Sphinx
runners.comment: SPHINX got bumped at the start by SHAKE MY HAND, chased four then three wide under encouragement from three furlongs out, tipped five wide into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Parea
runners.comment: PAREA reluctant to load prior to the start, spurted away in the two path opening up a commanding lead through swift splits, had the field take closer order though the latter portion of the turn and took the inside route into upper stretch under threat to the outside, yielded the front straightened away, folded along the rail and was eased home in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Kid's Khanclusion
runners.comment: KID'S KHANCLUSION hit the inside of the gate solidly at the start and was off slow, spotted the front several lengths, settled off the inside, moved to the three path while getting closer late on the far turn, rallied in the five path coming to the quarter-pole, swept to the front into upper stretch, drifted in while going clear outside the furlong marker then was put to a left-handed crop, was given one final pop of the crop outside the sixteenth-pole and proved much the best under a strong hand-ride to the finish.

runners.name: Brilliant Fury
runners.comment: BRILLIANT FURY broke out at the start, prompted the pace on the outside in the three then two path, was asked near the quarter-pole then came under a drive in upper stretch and proved no match for the winner while just able to get the place.

runners.name: Kotlikoff
runners.comment: KOTLIKOFF broke out at the start, settled off the early pace, rounded the first turn in the two path, raced towards the rear, moved closer in the two path on the far turn, drafted behind horses while passed by the winner late on that bend then shifted to the three path, came out to the six path into upper stretch and just missed the place while narrowly able to get the show.

runners.name: Tango Tango
runners.comment: TANGO TANGO was taken under a tight hold early, prompted inside on the first turn, dropped back in crowded quarters late on that bend, was rated just off the pace, saved ground on the far turn, was given his cue at the quarter-pole and lacked the needed kick then just missed the trifecta.

runners.name: Big Frosty
runners.comment: BIG FROSTY broke out at the start, stalked the pace on the outside in the four then three path, was asked on the far turn, chased in the four path into the stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Shenanigans Buck
runners.comment: SHENANIGANS BUCK went to the front, showed the way while two path to the inside, was asked near the quarter-pole then lost advantage to the winner into upper stretch, dropped back into the final furlong and tired.

runners.name: Whittington Park
runners.comment: WHITTINGTON PARK chased three then two paths off the rail down the backstretch until tucked inside five furlongs from home, rode the rail through the turn coming under coaxing at the seven-sixteenths marker, tipped out two then three wide at the five-sixteenths pole, angled six wide into upper stretch, rallied to take command just outside the eighth pole, drew clear to the finish to score.

runners.name: Shattuck
runners.comment: SHATTUCK chased four then three wide coming under urging three furlongs out, spun two to three wide into upper stretch, offered up a mild kick.

runners.name: Expensive Cut
runners.comment: EXPENSIVE CUT chased just off the inside under a ride from three furlongs out, spun three wide into upper stretch, offered up a mild kick to secure the show honors.

runners.name: Mike's Magic
runners.comment: MIKE'S MAGIC broke out at the start directly to the front filling the space left vacant by the breaking outwards SARA'S SHAMAN, showed the way in hand three then two wide coming under urging three furlongs out, spun three wide into upper stretch, dug in under threat to the outside and was collared just outside the eighth pole, then weakened through to the finish.

runners.name: Sara's Shaman
runners.comment: SARA'S SHAMAN broke out at the start bumping SALMING, chased four then three wide under encouragement from three furlongs out, continued three to four wide into upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Palace Boss
runners.comment: PALACE BOSS got away last to an awkward beginning, chased six paths off the inside down the backstretch and then four wide through the turn under urging from the three-eighths pole, went eight wide into upper stretch and passed tired rivals.

runners.name: Unbridled Bomber
runners.comment: UNBRIDLED BOMBER along the inside briefly, tipped out to chase three paths off the rail down the backstretch before tucking to the two path through the turn coming under prolonged coaxing half a mile from home, spun just off the inside into upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Swiss Army Knife
runners.comment: SWISS ARMY KNIFE chased five paths off the inside down the backstretch before tucking four then three wide through the turn put to urging with seven-sixteenths to go, tipped out five wide at the head of the stretch, tired.

runners.name: Lexington Pike
runners.comment: LEXINGTON PIKE chased four then three wide under a ride from the seven-sixteenths marker, went four wide for home, tired in the stretch.

runners.name: Salming
runners.comment: SALMING got bumped at the start by SARA'S SHAMAN, who broke outwards, chased seven paths off the inside down the backstretch and then four wide through the turn, went six to seven wide into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Storm Diva
runners.comment: STORM DIVA showed speed on the outside of foes then moved to a solo advantage late on the backstretch, dropped from the two path to the inside early on the turn, responded well when asked coming to the quarter-pole then came back off the inside, drew off under a strong hand-ride into the final furlong, was given one pop of a right-handed crop outside the sixteenth-pole and proved much the best under a solid hand-ride from that point to the finish.

runners.name: Split the Blanket
runners.comment: SPLIT THE BLANKET was hustled from the gate, showed speed then tracked the pace, was asked in the two path on the turn, chased the winner in the four path under a drive into upper stretch and proved no match while clear for the place.

runners.name: Magnum's Monsoon
runners.comment: MAGNUM'S MONSOON showed speed then prompted the pace, chased inside on the turn, dropped back while remaining on her inside lead in the stretch and weakened but held the show.

runners.name: Mia On Tap
runners.comment: MIA ON TAP was urged along near the back, steadied outside the nine-sixteenths pole, saved ground on the turn and failed to impact but earned the last spot in the superfecta.

runners.name: Zipline
runners.comment: ZIPLINE settled under some urging, traveled around the turn in the three path, spun into upper stretch in the five path and failed to rally.

runners.name: Truelies
runners.comment: TRUELIES was hustled from the gate, showed speed on the inside of opponents, was eased back off the pace near the eleven-sixteenths pole, moved from the inside to the two path while asked on the turn and came up empty.

runners.name: Penelope Rose
runners.comment: PENELOPE ROSE angled in while settling off the pace, went around the turn in the two then three path and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Good to Great
runners.comment: GOOD TO GREAT was urged along on the outside, went around the turn in the four path, was driven into upper stretch in the six path and failed to respond.

runners.name: Levina
runners.comment: LEVINA angled in while settling off the pace, rounded the turn in the three then four path, came out to the six path into upper stretch and was no factor.

runners.name: Charisma Command
runners.comment: CHARISMA COMMAND ran off some with the rider during the warm-up, moved her head just as the gate opened and was off very slow, spotted the front many lengths, moved out while reserved at the rear, tossed her head outside the five-eighths pole, traveled around the turn in the five path, spun into upper stretch in the seven path and never reached contention.

runners.name: Cool Intentions
runners.comment: COOL INTENTIONS dueled four then three wide with STRONSINO to his outside, came under coaxing with five-sixteenths to go, took over narrow command just outside the quarter pole and went seven wide into upper stretch, dug in under threat to the outside and gamely repelled the challenger to prevail by a head on the wire.

runners.name: Yo Daddy
runners.comment: YO DADDY hustled from the gate, raced five then four wide in closest aim of the duel up front, came under urging three furlongs out, went eight wide into upper stretch, rallied to latch on the top one to the outside, dug in through to the finish fighting on in game fashion but was ultimately rebuffed to the line while well clear of the rest.

runners.name: Classicist
runners.comment: CLASSICIST grew detached at the tail of the field four paths off the rail down the backstretch when devoid of speed, tucked to the two path into the turn and came under a ride with three furlongs to run, angled five to six wide into upper stretch and kicked on belatedly to the finish to procure the show honors.

runners.name: Full Screen
runners.comment: FULL SCREEN chased four then three wide under urging from the five-sixteenths pole, went nine wide into upper stretch and stayed on one paced to the finish.

runners.name: Stronsino
runners.comment: STRONSINO coaxed from the gate, dueled from the two path with COOL INTENTIONS to his outside, came under coaxing three furlongs from home, swung four to five wide into upper stretch narrowly displaced from command, then weakened through to the end.

runners.name: Tuscan Sky
runners.comment: TUSCAN SKY chased seven paths off the inside down the backstretch and then five wide through the turn under encouragement with five-sixteenths to run, went nine wide into upper stretch, came up empty.

runners.name: Classic Commander
runners.comment: CLASSIC COMMANDER broke a step slow, moved from the inside to the two path on the first turn, settled outside at the rear on the backstretch, was carried out inside the half-mile pole, went around the far turn in the four then five path, came into the stretch in the six path, rallied outside into the final furlong, closed fast into the final sixteenth then drifted in while getting to the leader and got up under good handling to prevail.

runners.name: Bourboncentric
runners.comment: BOURBONCENTRIC brushed the outside of the gate at the start, raced in the two path on the first turn, settled outside on the backstretch, was asked in the three then four path on the far turn, rallied to make a bid at the quarter-pole, came inward while narrowly in front in upper stretch, led into the final sixteenth but was caught while able to get the place.

runners.name: Fresh Start
runners.comment: FRESH START broke out at the start, moved in while establishing a forward position early, prompted the pace on the outside in the two path, drew even with the leader on the far turn, spun into the stretch in the three path, was carried in at the three-sixteenths pole, battled with the runner-up under a drive into the final sixteenth and was outfinished while able to get the show.

runners.name: Imperial Anthem
runners.comment: IMPERIAL ANTHEM went around the turns in the two to three path, came out to the five path into the stretch then moved further out and improved for the last spot in the superfecta.

runners.name: Emotionlyavailble
runners.comment: EMOTIONLYAVAILBLE was taken back before the first turn, tucked into the two path for the run around that bend, stalked outside on the backstretch, was given his cue in the two then three path on the far turn, chased in the four path into the stretch, pursued the leader in the drive and lacked the needed kick.

runners.name: Lobbyist
runners.comment: LOBBYIST dropped back early, saved ground on the first turn, settled towards the rear, moved out inside the half-mile pole, went around the far turn in the three then four path, turned into the stretch in the five path and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Zip for Rick
runners.comment: ZIP FOR RICK saved ground on the first turn, settled off the pace, was roused in the two path on the far turn and lacked the needed response.

runners.name: Thundertaker
runners.comment: THUNDERTAKER was hustled to the front, showed the way on the inside, was asked under threat on the far turn, spun into the stretch in the two path then lost the advantage, checked while weakening near the three-sixteenths pole and gave way.

runners.name: Strobe Light
runners.comment: STROBE LIGHT was taken in hand early then rated on the inside, saved ground through the far turn and came up empty.
